{{Quote|Bury them in ice!|[[Unger Gout]] giving an order during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]|<ref name="CW 7">[[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]]</ref>}}
'''Khorm''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|frozen]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was one of the few planets that contained an extremely rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] called [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] that could be used to [[Agrocite cannon|enhance]] the power of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. During [[Clone Wars/Legends|The Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Khormai [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Unger Gout]] betrayed his people and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] them to [[Mine/Legends|mine]] Agrocite for [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. This resulted in a major Republic offensive led by [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]] at the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]]. During the battle, both Gout and Tauht were killed, but in the end the Republic won with the help of native Khormai and air support from Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]], who, along with Fisto and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] "[[Sharp]]," destroyed Gout's powerful Agrocite cannons.

==Description==
[[File:Khorm.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The icy surface of Khorm]]
A land of frozen wastelands and blizzards, Khorm's entire surface was covered in [[Water/Legends|ice]] and snow, and, in spite of the extremely cold temperatures and harsh winds, a walrus-like [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]], managed to thrive there. It had a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. One of its most rare and valuable resources was an ore called [[Agrocite/Legends|Agrocite]] that, when converted to [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]], could greatly enhance the destructive power of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. This enticed the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] and [[Unger Gout]], a Khormai [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], to ally with each other to collect as much of the resource as possible. Because of the extensive mining done on the planet, there was a massive unnatural network of caves beneath the ice.<ref name="In Service of the Republic" /> It was located in the [[Khorm system/Legends|Khorm system]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="AOC" />

==History==
Years before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the native Khormai, who had developed the proper technology, discovered the enhancing effect of agrocite on turbolasers. Khorm was then peppered with mining facilities by the Khormai, and more were built as time went on, with the sole purpose of unearthing the rare ore. During this period, [[Unger Gout]] was born, and quickly rose to prominence in the government. He eventually took over and sold Khorm and its agrocite to [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="In Service of the Republic" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Main|Battle of Khorm/Legends}}
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], hoping to stop the mining of Agrocite for the Separatist cause, sent an attack force led by three [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]]: [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Tauht]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] to Khorm, where they obtained the aid of the [[Khormai resistance]] and one of its heads, [[Adaroo]]. However, Gout had predicted their arrival and constructed a [[weather-control station]] to create a planet-wide storm, powerful enough to prevent any air-support but still enabling the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to send ground troops. Soon, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces had begun to get the upper hand, which forced Gout to request reinforcements in the form of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. The Republic continued to advance toward the main mine, despite Tauht being slain after capturing a processing plant. Gout and Ventress then initiated a counter-attack, and kidnapped [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], [[Wolffe/Legends|Commander CC-3636]], and several other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].

[[File:Mine_assault.jpg|thumb|right|225px|Ozzel's air support attacks the mine.]]
Meanwhile, Koon and Fisto had destroyed the weather-control station, and Gout and Ventress retreated to the mine, where they kept the prisoners and slaves. While the Republic prisoners escaped, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived with their forces at the mine. The Dark Acolyte then had the mine rigged with explosives with the intention of killing the Khormai if the Republic conquered the mine. Finding the explosives, Koon and Fisto had Ozzel halt his advance as they infiltrated the mine and escorted the slaves to safety. Before they could exit the mine, Ozzel began his assault, and Gout revealed his [[agrocite cannon]] by destroying a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. "[[Sharp]]" and Fisto succeeded in destroying them before Ventress could destroy the mine, but she escaped.<ref name="In Service of the Republic" /> After the battle, it became host of a Republic Command Post for the rest of [[Clone Wars/Legends|the war]].<ref name="CW 9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Khorm was created for the [[2009]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|''In Service of the Republic'']] storyline of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series. The three issues of the storyline were written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]] and were illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]].<ref name="In Service of the Republic" />
